subject: Azure Marketplace private plan — co-sell revenue share & legal gaps
messages:
From: Azure Marketplace Partner Team <mktplace-pm@microsoft.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + private listing next steps for Contoso (Contoso SOW attached)

Hi Rishi & team,

Thanks for the call this morning. Per our discussion, Contoso qualifies for a private plan in the Azure Marketplace and we can support a co-sell motion if the commercial terms are aligned. I attached the partner onboarding checklist and a sample private-plan term sheet for you to review.

High-level items for your side:
- Confirm planned SKU(s) and unit economics (list price, meter SKU)
- Proposed revenue split and whether Microsoft co-sell rebate applies
- Any special indemnity or audit requests from Contoso procurement
- Listing metadata (data residency, support contacts, trial entitlements)

Can you confirm the preferred commercial structure by next Tue? We need to coordinate the marketplace entitlement draft and Contoso procurement.

Thanks,
Asha Raman
Azure Marketplace Partner Manager
Microsoft Corporation

Attachment: Contoso_Private_Onboarding_Checklist.pdf

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Azure Marketplace Partner Team <mktplace-pm@microsoft.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + private listing next steps for Contoso (Contoso SOW attached)

Thanks Asha — sending an initial term proposal and flagging a couple legal items we want to close before onboarding. Attaching a one-page term sheet (Redwood_Azure_PrivatePlan_TermSheet_v1.pdf) and the draft SOW Contoso asked us to review.

Key commercial points we propose:
- Marketplace meter SKU with list price billed by Microsoft, revenue share to Redwood: 70% net of Marketplace fee (so Microsoft takes marketplace fee + 30% as agreed)
- Microsoft co-sell rebate to Contoso handled via the usual co-sell program (we expect ~20% of net, subject to Microsoft confirmation)
- Monthly invoicing to Contoso directly (or via Marketplace if Contoso requires) — we need to confirm procurement preference

Legal issues to resolve (early flags):
1) Indemnity mutuality — Contoso added a broad IP indemnity; we should propose a carveout for open-source model components and downstream user prompts
2) Data processing & retention — Contoso wants 7 years retention for audit logs (we typically propose 90 days by default for KV caches; need to propose an exception approach)
3) Audit rights — Contoso wants on-prem audit access; Microsoft marketplace agreements restrict certain access patterns

Laura/hannah — can you please review the term points and the two legal flags? Marissa, can you confirm whether Sales Ops can accept monthly invoicing outside of Marketplace (Contoso asked about direct invoicing to speed POs)?

Rishi
Head of Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + private listing next steps for Contoso (Contoso SOW attached)

Rishi — quick read. High level OK on commercial split but we should tighten language on:
- Revenue waterfall: define "net of marketplace fee" (explicitly list which line items are deducted before split)
- Co-sell rebate flow: include a clause that rebates earned by Microsoft will be credited to Contoso, not Redwood, unless otherwise agreed (this avoids double-counting)

Legal flags (Hannah, please advise):
1) IP indemnity — propose replacing with: Redwood indemnifies for Redwood-delivered software and proven proprietary model artifacts; Contoso indemnifies for customer-provided data and prompt-driven claims.
2) Data retention — propose a two-tier approach: 90 days rolling logs (default) + 7-year archival only for audit records exported on request with approved redaction and export process; any archival retention requires procurement-level approval and fee schedule.
3) Audit scope — limit to provisioned logs + synthetic access; no direct access to Redwood internal systems or source code.

Marissa — for invoicing: if Contoso signs Marketplace private plan they prefer billing via Microsoft to use existing payment terms. Contoso procurement is open to direct invoicing only if we commit to Net45 and provide a PO. Which do we prefer for speed?

Laura
VP, Business Development | Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Apr 2027 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + private listing next steps for Contoso (Contoso SOW attached)

Rishi/Laura/Marissa — legal review below, high level: we can accept this commercial structure with the following edits before we circulate to Contoso: 

- Revenue definition: "Net Revenue" = gross Marketplace receipts less Marketplace fee, taxes collected on our behalf, refunds and chargebacks, and third-party pass-throughs. The 70% split applies to Net Revenue.
- Indemnity: accept Laura's carveout; add express carveout for model components that are open-source or licensed under third-party terms we cannot control. Contoso's IP indemnity language currently reads too broadly and must be narrowed.
- Data retention & audit: offer the two-tier approach; require Contoso to sign the export/access SOP (we will provide) and any archival storage will be billable — propose $0.02/GB-month as an initial number.
- Compliance evidence: provide SOC 2 Type II report and redacted audit logs (90 days) as part of onboarding; anything beyond that requires an engagement (billable).

I will prepare a redline of the term sheet and the SOW.

Next steps:
- I will circulate redline by EOD today.
- Rishi/Marissa: please confirm whether you want us to propose Marketplace-billing-first (faster to close) or direct invoicing (may speed PO but increases billing ops for Redwood).

Hannah Schmitt
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Daniel Kim <daniel.kim@contoso.com>, Procurement (Contoso) <procurement@contoso.com>
Cc: Asha Raman <mktplace-pm@microsoft.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Azure Marketplace private plan — co-sell revenue share & legal gaps

Daniel / Contoso procurement — looping you in with our proposed commercial approach and a few legal clarifications from our counsel. Attached: Redwood_Azure_PrivatePlan_TermSheet_v1.pdf (redline incoming) and the draft SOW Contoso shared.

TL;DR (proposal):
- Marketplace billing with Microsoft is preferred for speed; Redwood's proposed split: 70% to Redwood of "Net Revenue" (as defined by legal team).
- Microsoft co-sell program rebates are handled by Microsoft / Contoso per program rules; we will not double-credit rebates to Redwood.
- Data retention: default 90-day logs provided; 7-year archival available as a billable add-on with redaction/escape process.
- Indemnity: mutual indemnity with carveouts for open-source/third-party models and prompt-driven user content.

Action items for Contoso:
1) Confirm billing route (Marketplace billing vs Redwood direct invoice + PO)
2) Confirm acceptance of proposed Net Revenue waterfall clause or send alternate language
3) Confirm SOW line items and expected go-live window (we proposed June 1)

Happy to set a short call if helpful.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Platform Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Azure_PrivatePlan_TermSheet_v1.pdf, Contoso_SOW_draft.docx
